name: Add Rows
description: Append records or rows of values below what a sheet already has — order lines, the rows of a report, a list of employees. Records are matched to the columns Set Columns defined; without columns their values are written in order.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const ws = workbook.getWorksheet(sheet) || workbook.addWorksheet(sheet || 'Sheet1'); const keyed = (ws.columns || []).some((c) => c && c.key); (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []).forEach((r) => ws.addRow(Array.isArray(r) || keyed || r == null || typeof r !== 'object' ? r : Object.values(r))); return workbook; })() }}"}]
